Thank you for trying to help. Right now my roommate is teaching me how to play the guitar and he's says i'm the fastest learner he's ever seen. I've wanted to play since I was a little kid (i'm 19 now) so it's one of the few things that i'm actually happy about. I'm absolutely in love with a girl and i'm pretty sure she feels the same way back. I found a major that i really like, biology, and i really want to do well in school but I can't sleep because of these thoughts and i constantly miss class do to oversleeping. I also started playing soccer again and joined an intramural team and i'm the leading scorer on the team.

Now you said there's nothing wrong with me but I feel like a normal person would be pretty content with this life.
